attempted_claim: Let Q2 be the 2-adic field with normalized absolute value, C2 its completed algebraic closure, and P1_Berk the Berkovich projective line over C2 with Berkovich Fatou set defined by equicontinuity and Julia set its complement. For the polynomial family P_c(z)=z^2+c with parameter c in Q2, decide the wandering dichotomy: either (A) prove that for every c in Q2 the map P_c has no wandering Berkovich Fatou component, every component being eventually periodic of Rivera-Letelier attracting, indifferent, or basin type, or (B) exhibit one explicit c0 in Q2, given as a 2-adic expansion or rational, plus two critical-orbit and disk data proving a named Berkovich Fatou component U with pairwise disjoint forward iterates P_{c0}^n(U). A complete answer is a self-contained proof of (A) for all c in Q2 or a rigorous proof of (B) including the wandering disk orbit, its accumulation/Julia-set witness point, and verification that U is a genuine Fatou component.
decisive_failure: No proof of direction (A) and no explicit wandering example for direction (B) were produced. The wild-ramification theorems and the disk-orbit computations needed for either direction remain unverified, and the artifacts directory is empty, so nothing here supports a CLAIMED result.
